instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Rank rows by page_view within each user_id
output: SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY page_view DESC) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Dense rank of rows by page_view
output: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY page_view DESC) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Row number per user_id ordered by visit_at
output: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Running total of page_view ordered by visit_at
output: SELECT *, SUM(page_view) OVER (ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Running total of page_view per user_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Average of page_view over all rows
output: SELECT *, AVG(page_view) OVER () FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Previous page_view value (lag) per user_id
output: SELECT *, LAG(page_view, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Next page_view value (lead) per user_id
output: SELECT *, LEAD(page_view, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Maximum page_view per user_id across all rows
output: SELECT *, MAX(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Minimum page_view per user_id
output: SELECT *, MIN(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Moving average window of 3 rows per user_id
output: SELECT *, AVG(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Window frame from first row to current per user_id
output: SELECT *, SUM(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
First value of page_view per user_id
output: SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Last value of page_view per user_id across full partition
output: SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Percent rank of page_view
output: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY page_view) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Cumulative distribution of page_view
output: SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY page_view) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Quartile bucket using NTILE
output: SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY page_view) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Difference of page_view from its group max
output: SELECT user_id, page_view, page_view - MAX(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS diff FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Rank of page_view with ties allowed to skip
output: SELECT user_id, page_view, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY page_view DESC) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Sliding window of total over preceding 5 rows
output: SELECT *, SUM(page_view) OVER (ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Running count per user_id
output: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Top 2 by page_view within each user_id using ROW_NUMBER
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY page_view DESC) rn FROM visits) x WHERE rn <= 2;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Nth value of page_view within partition
output: SELECT *, NTH_VALUE(page_view, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Expressed ratio of page_view to group total
output: SELECT user_id, page_view, page_view / SUM(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS ratio FROM visits;

instruction:
Schema: visits(user_id, page_view, visit_at)
Window with custom unbounded following frame
output: SELECT *, SUM(page_view) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY visit_at ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM visits;
